ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area punctuated by discrete high-intensity (white) circular clusters; estimated ratio of 75% low to 25% high intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular blobs concentrated in the distal regions and along the trailing edge of both lobes; central region surrounding the median notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an acute angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is approximately 1/8th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged, irregular boundary along the trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude pixel-level peaks and valleys, especially concentrated on the lateral thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) appearing as white spots on a dark background across both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'polka-dot' pigmentation pattern characterized by isolated, high-contrast circular marks rather than contiguous marbling.
